readSpanView.calls: At a call, fixed Published parameter structural effects are applied to mapped actual owner roots before the atomic View-actual use-completion. A View argument remains held through the call even if callee body/Derived is unread or Published.read=false. For every View family live through this call (last_use >= this call, including equality), a may-alias mapped structural owner is rejected. Distinct caller fresh owners may prove non-alias; formal Array/View owners conservatively may alias. No function specialization or global all-call rejection. Process effects and actual View operand use-completion first; only then register an Array-origin returned family. An existing family is active at a call only if its origin is a parameter or its create/call origin instruction is strictly before this call, with last_use>=call. The new family is not live during its own creating call. View-origin results extend the existing family through future uses/return. This ordering never exempts other pre-existing borrows of the mapped owner.

A checked local View has owner {kind:array,register:canonical Array root} and origin {kind:create,instruction}. A View-result call whose independently verified callee returnOrigin selects an Array formal maps the actual canonical Array owner and starts a NEW family with origin {kind:call,instruction:actual call}; it begins only after that call completes. If it selects a View formal, inherit the exact actual View family/owner/origin, including every returned alias; do not create a new family or merge different origins merely because owners match. Every View SSA including unused/discarded/tail call results has a distinct normalized row. View read/length/alias/call-actual/return operands extend the shared family last use, even when Published.read=false or the callee body does not read. Core last_use is null only for a formal family with no actual View operand use or a newly created checked-create/Array-origin-call family with no such use. Every view_alias uses its View operand, so its inherited row has nonnull final family last_use >= the alias instruction. Every View-origin call necessarily uses its selected actual View operand through completion, so every inherited result row has nonnull final family last_use >= its defining call, including discarded results; a tail return extends it to func.return. All rows of one family share the exact final last_use. Source plan create-complete events denote birth; they do not invent a Core View-operand use. Direct mutation conflicts only after origin creation and strictly before last use; call structural effects conflict through inclusive call last use.
